items.t: سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ بِحَوْلِهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ {فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الخَالِقِينَ}
items.r: التّرمذي 2/ 474 وأحمد 6/ 30 والحاكم وصححه ووافقه الذهبي 1/ 220 والزيادة له
items.en: My face fell prostrate before He who created it and brought forth its faculties of hearing and seeing by His might and power.<< So Blessed is Allah, the best of creators.
items.tl: Sajada wajhiya lilladhī khalaqahu, washaqqa samʿahu wa baṣarahu bi-ḥawlihi wa quwwatihi, fa tabraka llāhu aḥsanu l-khāliqīn

items.t: اللَّهُمَّ أُكْتُبْ لِي بِهَا عِنْدَكَ أَجْرًا، وَضَعْ عَنِّي بِهَا وِزْرًا، وَاجْعَلْهَا لِي عِنْدَكَ ذُخْرًا، وَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنِّي كَمَا تَقَبَّلْتَهَا مِنْ عَبْدِكَ دَاوُدْ
items.en: O Allah, record for me a reward for this prostration, and remove from me a sin. Save it for me and accept it from me just as You had accepted it from Your servant Dawood.
items.tl: Allāhumma iktub lī bihā ʿindaka ajran, waḍaʿ ʿannī bihā wizran, wa ijʿalhā lī ʿindaka dhukhran, wa taqabbalhā minnī kamā taqabbaltahā min ʿabdika dāwud
